epics.title: vision: M0 Foundations
goals: Replay a video file locally (ONNX Runtime, no Hailo) into valid ObservationFrame JSONL (vision-01)
Hailo readiness decided without the device: model variants, HEF source, versions (vision-02 ADR)
Zone calibration (bin slots, plating spot, wash, clean stack, pass) with a click tool
Identity rules with safety tests: re-acquired tracks always get new IDs, origin set correctly (invariant 8)
Recorded frame JSONL fixture pack that interactions, sim and the partner test against
Per-frame change masks, live and in recordings, from the shared function (vision-13)

epics.title: vision: M1 Vertical Slice
goals: Every frame goes to the partner's EntityStore (FakeEntityStore until it lands) and to interactions, without blocking
POST /v1/plates/start binds exactly one plate and refuses otherwise
GET /v1/health and GET /stream.mjpg
Frame recorder with byte-identical replay
FakeVisionAPI so outputs can build the start-ticket button, gate fault handling and overlays

Fine-tune the detector or remap classes only if COCO tools and bowls are too weak from overhead

tasks.title: vision: replay a video locally (ONNX Runtime) into ObservationFrame JSONL
tasks.goal: Run the vision pipeline on a laptop with no Hailo: a video file goes through YOLOv8 det+pose exported to ONNX and run with ONNX Runtime, shared post-processing, and ByteTrack, and comes out as valid ObservationFrame JSONL. This is the default backend until the Hailo is connected.
acceptance: `uv run python -m kitchen.vision.run --video <file> --out frames.jsonl` writes one ObservationFrame per processed frame (kitchen/vision/run.py, camera.py)

A Detector interface (kitchen/vision/detect.py) with an `onnx` backend: pretrained YOLOv8 detection (knife, spoon, fork, bowl) and YOLOv8 pose, exported once to fixed-shape ONNX (ultralytics is only the exporter) and run with ONNX Runtime. Pose wrists go through kitchen/vision/pose.py. ByteTrack runs behind a Tracker interface (kitchen/vision/track.py)
Hands are emitted as kind=hand, class_name=wrist, with person_id and wrist [x, y, conf]. Bowls are emitted as kind=plate, tools as kind=tool
A provisional identity gives each track an entity_id and origin (shift_start in the first second, unknown after). vision-04 replaces it
Every line validates against observation_frame (including the required per-detection origin): `uv run pytest kitchen/vision -k replay_contract`
Frame t_ms comes from the injected Clock (video timestamps) and is strictly increasing: a `safety` test
Running the replay twice on the same input gives identical JSONL: `uv run pytest kitchen/vision -k deterministic`
The sample clip is listed in kitchen/vision/data-manifest.json, not committed. A fixture of 50 KB or less is committed under kitchen/vision/tests/fixtures/
The README documents the command and the AGPL-3.0 note for ultralytics (OQ-16)
VISION_DETECTOR defaults to onnx; letterbox, decoding and NMS live in kitchen/vision/postprocess.py, not inside the backend: test_backend_has_no_postprocessing passes
Runs on macOS and Linux without any Hailo package installed: the CI job imports kitchen.vision with only the default extras
out_of_scope: Zones and slot-based bin identity (vision-03, vision-04)

tasks.title: vision: Hailo readiness spike (no device): variants, HEF path, versions
tasks.goal: Without the device, decide how vision will be uploaded to the Hailo-8: which YOLOv8 det and pose variants and input size the Hailo Model Zoo supports, whether precompiled HEFs exist for them, what the Dataflow Compiler needs if we compile ourselves (OQ-18), and which HailoRT and Pi OS versions to install. Written up as an ADR.
acceptance: ADR in docs/decisions/ naming the det and pose variants, input size, and HEF source (Model Zoo or compile), with links to the sources checked
The chosen variants run locally through vision-01's ONNX path (variant names match)
A list of what the owner must install on the Pi when the Hailo is connected, with versions, posted on the issue
Any unverified claim is marked unverified in the ADR
out_of_scope: Running anything on a Hailo device

tasks.title: vision: zone calibration format, click tool and assignment
tasks.goal: Bin slots, the plating spot, the wash station, the clean stack and the pass are defined once as normalized polygons, and every detection gets a zone (or null).
acceptance: Zone file format in kitchen/vision/zones.py (zone_id, kind in bin_slot | plating_spot | wash | clean_stack | pass | other, polygon of normalized points), with a validator test
`uv run python -m kitchen.vision.zones calibrate --image <still.jpg> --out zones.json` lets a person click polygons and save them
Point-in-polygon assignment for detections, with unit tests covering edges and overlapping zones (deterministic tie-break). A detection in no zone gets zone null, never a guess
A sample zones.json is committed under kitchen/vision/tests/fixtures/ for interactions and outputs
If the zone file must cross a team boundary as a contract, a `type:rfc` issue proposes a `zone` schema (today only the Zone dataclass in kitchen/shared/models.py exists)

tasks.title: vision: entity identity rules with new-ID-on-reacquire and origin
tasks.goal: Map tracks to stable entity IDs (bin-<slot>, tool-<class>-<n>, hand-p<k>-left|right, plate-<n>) and set each entity's origin, so a lost and re-acquired track is always a new entity with unknown history (invariant 8).
acceptance: kitchen/vision/identity.py assigns entity_id, origin and first_seen from track IDs, classes, slot zones and pose person IDs
`safety` test: a track lost beyond the track buffer and re-acquired gets a new entity_id with origin unknown
`safety` property test (hypothesis): entity IDs are never reused within a shift, over random track lifetimes
`safety` test: a person re-acquired by pose gets new hand IDs
origin is shift_start for entities seen before shift start, clean_stack only when first seen leaving a clean_stack zone, and unknown otherwise. One `safety` test per case
Bins take their ID from their slot zone (bin-4 is whatever sits in slot-4). The README says swapping bins between slots mid-shift is unsupported
`uv run pytest kitchen/vision -m safety` passes
out_of_scope: Any re-identification or merging of tracks (that needs an RFC and the safety reviewer)

tasks.title: vision: publish recorded frame JSONL fixture pack
tasks.goal: Ship the fake that consumers test against: small, real, recorded ObservationFrame JSONL clips covering the core interaction shapes.
acceptance: At least 4 fixtures under kitchen/vision/tests/fixtures/pack/: a knife scoop in a bin slot, a hand touching a plate, a tool leaving and re-entering the frame (new entity ID, origin unknown), and a plate taken from the clean stack (origin clean_stack)
Each fixture is 100 KB or less, validates against observation_frame, and has a README line saying what happens and when
The JSONL replay source in kitchen/vision/camera.py streams a pack file in-process: `uv run pytest kitchen/vision -k fixture_pack`
Announced on the interactions and sim Team boards, plus an owner:partner issue (the partner's entity store tests use it)
out_of_scope: Labels or expected events (interactions owns those)

tasks.title: vision: feed the entity store and interactions every frame
tasks.goal: Wire kitchen/vision/run.py so every ObservationFrame goes to EntityStore.ingest and to the interactions consumer without ever blocking the frame loop, and write zones once at startup. FakeEntityStore stands in for the partner's store until it lands.
acceptance: Each frame is delivered exactly once and in order to EntityStore.ingest and to a registered interactions consumer: `uv run pytest kitchen/vision -k fanout`
The frame loop never blocks on a slow consumer (test with a deliberately slow FakeEntityStore). Drops or backlog are counted and exposed for /v1/health
At startup, zones from zones.json are written once via StateClient.set_zones (InMemoryStateClient test)
Fake-swap test: fixture pack, then run.py, then FakeEntityStore with start_sync into InMemoryStateClient. The entity rows match the pack's entity IDs and origins
needs-partner: once the partner's EntityStore passes the kitchen/shared/contract_tests suite, the same fake-swap test passes against it (command and output in the PR)
out_of_scope: The entity store and 5 Hz sync themselves (partner)

tasks.title: vision: POST /v1/plates/start binds exactly one plate
tasks.goal: When the cook taps start ticket, bind the single plate in the plating-spot zone to the ticket and write plate_binding. Never guess.
acceptance: kitchen/vision/plates.py plus server.py: exactly one plate in plating_spot calls StateClient.bind_plate(plate_id, ticket_id, t_ms) and returns {plate_id}

`safety` tests: no plate gives 409 no_plate_at_spot, two or more give 409 multiple_plates_at_spot, and a plate already bound to another ticket gives 409 plate_already_bound and is never silently rebound
Error bodies follow {"error": {"code", "message"}}. CORS origins come from VISION_CORS_ORIGINS
`uv run pytest kitchen/vision -k plates_start` passes against InMemoryStateClient

tasks.title: vision: GET /v1/health and GET /stream.mjpg
tasks.goal: Expose liveness for the pass gate, which faults when health goes stale, and the raw camera stream for overlays.
acceptance: /v1/health returns {fps, hailo, last_frame_t_ms}. last_frame_t_ms stops advancing when frames stop (`safety` test with a stalled source)
/stream.mjpg serves MJPEG from the active source. A smoke test reads at least 3 JPEG parts
The endpoints never block the frame loop (test with a slow client)
The README shows curl commands for both

tasks.title: vision: frame recorder with byte-identical replay
tasks.goal: Record any source's ObservationFrames to JSONL with a session manifest, and replay them so downstream output is identical. This underpins M2's deterministic live-session replay and the interactions dataset.
acceptance: `uv run python -m kitchen.vision.record --source <video|camera> --out <dir>` writes frames.jsonl plus manifest.json (source, versions, zones file hash, shift start, model versions)
Record, then replay, round-trips byte for byte: `uv run pytest kitchen/vision -k roundtrip`
The replay source keeps the recorded t_ms and can pace in real time or run as fast as possible
Large recordings go to data/ (gitignored), and the manifest entry format is documented

tasks.title: vision: FakeVisionAPI for outputs
tasks.goal: Give outputs a stand-in for the Pi so they can build the start-ticket button, the gate fault logic and overlays without hardware.
acceptance: `uv run python -m kitchen.vision.server --fake --port 8080` serves the three Vision HTTP API endpoints
/v1/plates/start answers in sequence from a script file (success, no_plate_at_spot, multiple_plates_at_spot, plate_already_bound)
/v1/health can be made stale on command, to exercise the gate fault
/stream.mjpg loops a generated test pattern (no committed video)
Contract tests check response shapes against contracts/apis.md: `uv run pytest kitchen/vision -k fake_api`

tasks.title: vision: Hailo backend behind Detector, tested on a mock runtime
tasks.goal: Implement kitchen/vision/hailo.py so switching VISION_DETECTOR=hailo is the only change needed once the device is connected. Test locally against a mock HailoRT; device verification waits for the owner.
acceptance: hailo.py feeds raw outputs to the same postprocess.py as the ONNX backend: a mock-runtime test returns detections identical to the ONNX backend on the same fixture tensors
Importing kitchen.vision never imports HailoRT unless VISION_DETECTOR=hailo: test_no_hailo_import_by_default passes
A device error stops frames (health goes stale) instead of producing detections: `safety` test with a failing mock runtime
Hardware test script posted on the issue for the owner to run once the Hailo is connected; the issue then moves to status:needs-human
out_of_scope: Performance tuning beyond the spike's recommendation

tasks.title: vision: Hailo deploy bundle and ONNX-vs-HEF parity script
tasks.goal: Make vision ready to upload: export.py builds data/models/<name>/ with fixed-shape ONNX, calibration frames from our recordings, manifest.json and the HEF step chosen in vision-02, plus a parity script the owner runs on the Pi once the Hailo is connected.
acceptance: `uv run python -m kitchen.vision.export --weights <w> --calib <recording> --out data/models/<name>` produces model.onnx, calib/ and manifest.json; the manifest validates against a schema test
The bundle's model.onnx is the exact file the local ONNX backend loads (same sha256 recorded in the manifest)
A parity script compares detections from two backends on one recording (box IoU and score tolerances from config), demonstrated locally as ONNX vs ONNX
data-manifest.json entry for the bundle; nothing over 1 MB committed
README section 'Local now, Hailo later' updated with the exact commands
out_of_scope: Running the Hailo compiler or device (owner, once connected)

tasks.title: vision: per-frame change mask in the loop and in recordings
tasks.goal: Compute a change mask for every frame with kitchen/shared/change_mask.py, hand it over in-process with each ObservationFrame, and record it as change.npz next to frames.jsonl, so interactions can build clips for the partner's ConvLSTM from live and recorded video.
acceptance: `uv run python -m kitchen.vision.run --video <file> --out <dir>` writes frames.jsonl and change.npz (uint8, downscaled to the clip H x W, one mask per frame, keyed by t_ms): test_change_sidecar
Uses only kitchen/shared/change_mask.py with parameters from config, recorded in the session manifest; no local mask code: test_uses_shared_mask
A static stretch of the sample clip gives near-zero masks and a moving hand gives a bright region over the hand: test_mask_sanity
Replay returns the same masks byte for byte: test_mask_replay
Adds less than 5 ms per frame on a laptop at 128 x 128, reported in the PR
out_of_scope: Tuning mask parameters beyond the OQ-20 defaults
